  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Douglas Salinas (E045) is a full-time Engineer. Requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin only if their role owns the system (Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist, not Engineer). Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by IT agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: IT database confirms Douglas Salinas (E045) is an Engineer. Full-time employee, so maximum access is write (admin only if role owns system; Engineer does not own Payroll). Requested write, which equals the maximum. Recommend write.
Note 3 (ticket 1), written by Finance agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Finance database confirms Douglas Salinas (E045) is an Engineer. Full-time employee, so maximum access is write (admin only if role owns the system; Engineer does not own Payroll). Requested write, which equals the maximum. Recommend write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Compliance database confirms Douglas Salinas (E045) is an Engineer. Full-time employee; maximum access is write (admin only if role owns system; Engineer does not own Payroll). Requested write equals maximum. Recommend write.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Facilities database confirms Douglas Salinas (E045) is an Engineer. Full-time employee per HR note, so maximum access is write (admin only if role owns the system; Engineer does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum. Recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security database shows Douglas Salinas (E045) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training means maximum is read. Requested write is above maximum, so recommend read.
reason: Security agent's independently verified database shows E045 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Since training is basic, the maximum access is read. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.
